scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --import=.firebase/emulator-export --export-on-exit=.firebase/emulator-export
scripts.emulators:exec: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --import=.firebase/emulator-export --export-on-exit=.firebase/emulator-export
scripts.emulators:backup: bash -c 'ts=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p .firebase/backups; if [ -d .firebase/emulator-export ] && [ -n "$(ls -A .firebase/emulator-export)" ]; then cp -R .firebase/emulator-export .firebase/backups/emulator-export-$ts && echo "Backup saved to .firebase/backups/emulator-export-$ts"; else echo "No emulator-export data to back up (run npm run emulators:export first)."; fi'
